name: VDB Value Accessor Caching
definition: A caching mechanism for coordinate-based value queries in VDB structures that achieves average constant-time access by exploiting spatial coherence and a fixed four-level tree depth.
summary: VDB Value Accessor Caching accelerates coordinate-based value retrieval in OpenVDB by using a hybrid bottom-up and top-down traversal to exploit spatial coherence, achieving average constant time complexity.
